lines.tts: [intrigued] This caveman invented something you pay for every month... and pray you never use.
lines.text: This caveman invented something you pay for every month... and pray you never use.

lines.tts: [sad, gruff] Every fire... Thog start from zero.
lines.text: Every fire... Thog start from zero.

lines.tts: [excited, gruff] Everyone put one fish in pot. Every moon.
lines.text: Everyone put one fish in pot. Every moon.

lines.tts: [proud] If YOUR hut burn... pot build new hut!
lines.text: If YOUR hut burn... pot build new hut!

lines.tts: [warm] Fires were rare... so the pot kept growing.
lines.text: Fires were rare... so the pot kept growing.

lines.tts: [triumphant] The pot paid. New hut in one day!
lines.text: The pot paid. New hut in one day!

lines.tts: That's insurance. Many people pay a little, so nobody loses everything.
lines.text: That's insurance. Many people pay a little, so nobody loses everything.

lines.tts: [slowly] One week later... Bonk's hut caught fire. Again.
lines.text: One week later... Bonk's hut caught fire. Again.

lines.tts: [dry] And that's how insurance fraud was invented.
lines.text: And that's how insurance fraud was invented.
